acceptance_criteria: Backend returns dedicated AlreadyExists error; handler maps it to SetError{type:alreadyExists, existingId}; test imports same blob twice and checks error
description: RFC 8621 §5.7 specifies that if a Message-ID being imported already exists in the mailstore, the server MUST return a SetError of type 'alreadyExists' and include the id of the existing Email in the error. Currently handle_email_import (email.rs lines 916–1061) calls backend.import_email but does not document or guarantee alreadyExists handling. The MailBackend trait's import_email method does not have a defined error variant for this case.
title: Email/import: handle duplicate Message-ID (alreadyExists)
